# Artificial Intelligence

## Overview

Artificial Intelligence concepts and related [project ideas](./project-ideas.md) intersect with [hardware](./hardware.md) prototyping, mobile [networking](./networking.md) experiments, and automated [knowledge management](./knowledge-management.md) systems. Notably, exploratory concepts include self-maintaining [documentation](./documentation.md) patterns and smart device integrations.

## Key Details

- **[Nova](./nova-widget.md) Prototypes:** [Hardware development](./hardware-development.md) efforts requiring components such as CR2032 batteries (x4).
- **Plant Whisperer:** A proposed application concept designed to alert users when soil is dry, with potential integration into the [Nova widget](./nova-widget.md) ecosystem and monetization via stickers.
- **Reverse Mesh:** An experimental project idea exploring the use of consumer phones as network nodes.
- **Self-Maintaining Wiki:** A late-night conceptual thought exploring autonomous, LLM-driven documentation maintenance patterns (referencing the "llm wiki pattern").
- **Design Notes:** Physical enclosure design for hardware prototypes emphasizes an organic, pebble-like aesthetic.
